emailIntro: Configure SMTP for notification emails sent by this instance.
unavailable: Your operator needs to configure the notification encryption key on the API and worker before saving connections.
passwordHint: Leave blank to keep the saved password. Credentials are never displayed after saving.
queued: Test queued. Check delivery history for the result.
integrationsIntro: Connect email, Slack, or webhooks to receive this project's alerts.
alertsIntro: Notify your team about new errors, recurring issues, or slow database calls.
noAccess: You need permission to manage project settings to configure notifications.
name: Name
secretHint: Use at least 32 characters. Keep a copy for your webhook receiver; Jekimo will not display it again.
channelHint: Messages may contain issue titles or database operation names. Only connect destinations authorized to receive this project’s data. Webhooks require a public HTTPS address.
noChannels: No connections yet. Add one to start sending alerts.
cooldown: Minimum minutes between alerts for the same issue
deliveryIntro: Latest 100 deliveries. Sent means accepted by the receiving service.
noDeliveries: No notifications have been queued yet.

deliveryError.generic: Delivery failed. Check the connection settings.

queryCooldown: Minimum minutes between alerts for this rule
queryAlertHint: Matches recorded calls at or above the threshold. Optional filters match exact names. Changes apply to newly received calls; sampling may omit calls.
